stories.title: Matt Olson Plays in His 900th Consecutive Game

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Matt Olson has now played in 900 consecutive games.

Streak started May 2, 2021. Braves beat the Yankees 2-1 Sunday — and Olson was there for game No. 900.

He's 8th all-time in MLB history. He's not done. 🔥 #Braves #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Matt Olson just hit a milestone no other active player is close to.

900 consecutive games. Since May 2, 2021.

He passed Stan Musial (895) last week for sole 8th on the all-time list. The next target: Joe Sewell at 1,103. #Braves #MLB #IronMan
